briefing.headline: OpenAI o4-preview deployment triggers global safety scramble as US-China tensions spike

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: AI development accelerates with frontier labs releasing advanced models amid record funding. Regulatory pressures mount while compute shortages persist. The race toward AGI shows no signs of slowing.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI ships o4-preview with enhanced reasoning. Anthropic counters with Claude 4 Opus. Google DeepMind and Meta push multimodal updates while xAI and DeepSeek expand open weights.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems. Regulators demand stronger controls as new exploits surface. DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level across multi-agent and IoT environments.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: NVIDIA Blackwell ramps hit supply constraints. Microsoft and Google announce new 100k GPU clusters. TSMC accelerates 2nm AI chip production for 2027 delivery.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will the first AGI system emerge from a US or Chinese lab by 2028?
